products.name: Pack
products.role: Chrome extension for filed GST returns
products.job: Saves filed GSTR-3B and GSTR-1 PDFs, the GSTR-1 e-invoice Excel where the portal provides it, and the GSTR-2B summary PDF from the GST portal to your computer.
products.proof: Open source under Apache 2.0, with release notes, privacy policy and security policy on GitHub.

products.name: Tools

products.name: Axal

products.name: Bridge

policySummary.evidence: Astro build and aggregate rendered checks

sections.title: Current scope
sections.body: This status page covers the open public-site repository, static build gates, route migration readiness, and review evidence. It is not a private Axal app uptime page and does not report tenant service health.

sections.title: Build posture
sections.body: ComplyEaze, Axal, and Pack build independently as static Astro apps from typed manifests. ComplyEaze marks each route indexed, unlisted, or review-only, and the robots directive and sitemap follow that marking; Axal and Pack stay noindex previews. Release gates require lint, typecheck, tests, build, aggregate release evidence, visual screenshots, public-content checks, link checks, metadata checks, git diff --check, and review-thread clearance. Rollback is a Git revert backed by retained CI artifacts; for search indexing, rollback means setting routes to unlisted or review-only while robots.txt keeps allowing crawling.

sections.title: Governance posture
sections.body: Legal governance, repository-settings gates, contributor-intake rules, dependency-surface policy, CODEOWNERS, and issue contact links are checked by scripts/check-public-repo.mjs so source-license, trademark, supply-chain, review, and public-issue boundaries cannot drift silently.

sections.title: Migration posture
sections.body: The typed manifests now own 16 ComplyEaze routes, seven Axal routes, and two Pack routes, including three noindex craft-review records. The old string renderer and its duplicate adapters are removed. complyeaze.com is served from this repository; Axal and Pack path routing remains pending, and route-level cleanup of private-app routes stays blocked until hosted routing, canonical URLs, redirect behavior, rollback evidence, and a separate private-app cleanup PR are reviewed.

sections.title: Hosting posture
sections.body: complyeaze.com is deployed from master through GitHub Pages while ENABLE_GITHUB_PAGES_DEPLOY is true. On 2026-09-30 the owner approved search and AI-assistant indexing of the pages marked indexed. A Pages deploy is not evidence for removing or redirecting any private-app route, so cleanup stays blocked.

sections.title: Incident language
sections.body: A public status update in this repo must distinguish static-site build or content issues from authenticated app incidents. Do not publish customer, tenant, credential, portal, or production infrastructure details here.
